description: Post a review on a pull request: an overall summary plus optional inline comments on specific lines. Inline comments must target lines in the PR's diff (RIGHT = new version, LEFT = removed lines); they're all checked first, and nothing is posted if any is invalid. Defaults to a neutral COMMENT review. Use dryRun to preview. Requires a GITHUB_TOKEN that can write to pull requests. Only post when the user has asked you to.

comments.description: Inline comments; each line must be part of the PR's diff

line.description: Line number the comment applies to

path.description: File path as shown in the PR, e.g. 'src/index.ts'

side.description: RIGHT = line in the new version (added/unchanged), LEFT = line in the old version (removed)

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the review without posting it

event.description: COMMENT (default) leaves feedback without a verdict; REQUEST_CHANGES and APPROVE set the review status

name: post_review_comment
title: Post pull request review
